title: Telling a longer story: tying it all together
title_target: ເລົ່າໃຫ້ຟັງ — Lào hài fáng
goal: Weave everything you've learned into a whole story: telling it, giving your opinion, responding to other people's stories, and saying a warm goodbye — the final unit that ties the previous nineteen together.
bekal: linking long sentences with ທີ່ and ເພາະວ່າ
giving opinions with ຄິດວ່າ and ຮູ້ສຶກວ່າ

dialogs.title: ບົດສົນທະນາ — The last evening before Budi goes home on leave
dialogs.intro: A year has gone by. Notice that this dialog uses almost every pattern you've learned — and that there isn't a single new verb form.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ປີ|Pii][ໜຶ່ງ|nʉ̀ng][ຜ່ານ|phàan][ໄປ|pai][ໄວ|vái][ເນາະ|nāw] [ເຈົ້າ|Jâo][ຮູ້ສຶກ|hûu-sʉ̀k][ແນວ|neeo][ໃດ|dai][ແດ່|dèe]
lines.id: A year went by fast, didn't it? How do you feel?
lines.literal: year — one — pass — go — fast — right? you — feel — way — which — (plural)?

lines.speaker: ບູດີ:
lines.text: [ຂ້ອຍ|Khàwy][ຄິດ|khit][ວ່າ|vàa][ປີ|pii][ນີ້|nîi][ເປັນ|pen][ປີ|pii][ທີ່|thìi][ດີ|dii][ທີ່ສຸດ|thìi-sút][ໃນ|nai][ຊີວິດ|síi-wit] [ຕອນ|Tawn][ມາ|maa][ໃໝ່ໆ|mài-mài] [ຂ້ອຍ|khàwy][ເວົ້າ|vâo][ບໍ່|bàw][ໄດ້|dâi][ຈັກ|ják][ຄຳ|khám]

lines.literal: I — think — that — year — this — be — year — that — good — most — in — life. time — come — new-new — I — speak — not — can — how-many — word.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ດຽວນີ້|Dǐao-nîi][ເວົ້າ|vâo][ໄດ້|dâi][ຄ່ອງ|khàwng][ຫຼາຍ|lǎai] [ຂ້ອຍ|Khàwy][ພູມໃຈ|phúum-jai][ນຳ|nám][ເຈົ້າ|jâo]
lines.id: Now you speak really fluently. I'm proud of you.
lines.literal: now — speak — can — fluent — much. I — proud — along — you.

lines.speaker: ບູດີ:
lines.text: [ເພາະ|Phaw][ວ່າ|vàa][ເຈົ້າ|jâo][ຊ່ວຍ|sùay][ຝຶກ|fʉ̀k][ໃຫ້|hài][ທຸກ|thuk][ອາທິດ|aa-thit] [ຖ້າ|Thàa][ບໍ່|bàw][ມີ|míi][ເຈົ້າ|jâo] [ຂ້ອຍ|khàwy][ຄົງ|khóng][ຊິ|si][ຍັງ|nyáng][ບໍ່|bàw][ໄດ້|dâi][ຫຍັງ|nyǎng]
lines.id: Because you helped me practice every week. Without you, I probably still couldn't do anything.
lines.literal: because — that — you — help — practice — give — every — week. if — not — have — you — I — probably — will — still — not — get — anything.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ຢ່າ|Yàa][ເວົ້າ|vâo][ແນວ|neeo][ນັ້ນ|nân] [ເຈົ້າ|Jâo][ເອງ|éeng][ທີ່|thìi][ຂະຫຍັນ|kha-nyǎn] [ສິ່ງ|Sìng][ທີ່|thìi][ຂ້ອຍ|khàwy][ມັກ|mak][ທີ່ສຸດ|thìi-sút] [ແມ່ນ|mèen][ເຈົ້າ|jâo][ບໍ່|bàw][ເຄີຍ|khóei][ຢ້ານ|yâan][ເວົ້າ|vâo][ຜິດ|phít]
lines.id: Don't say that. You're the one who worked hard. What I like most is that you were never afraid of making mistakes.
lines.literal: don't — speak — way — that. you — self — who — diligent. thing — that — I — like — most — be — you — not — ever — afraid — speak — wrong.

lines.speaker: ບູດີ:
lines.text: [ຕອນ|Tawn][ທຳອິດ|tham-ít][ຢ້ານ|yâan][ຫຼາຍ|lǎai] [ແຕ່|Tèe][ຄົນ|khón][ລາວ|Láao][ໃຈດີ|jai dii][ຫຼາຍ|lǎai] [ເລີຍ|Lóei][ບໍ່|bàw][ຢ້ານ|yâan][ອີກ|ìik]
lines.id: At first I was really scared. But Lao people are so kind that I wasn't scared anymore.
lines.literal: time — first — afraid — much. but — person — Lao — kind — much. so — not — afraid — again.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ເມື່ອ|Mʉ̂a][ໃດ|dai][ຊິ|si][ກັບ|kap][ມາ|maa]

lines.speaker: ບູດີ:
lines.text: [ເດືອນ|Dʉan][ໜ້າ|nâa] [ຂ້ອຍ|Khàwy][ຕໍ່|taw][ສັນຍາ|sǎn-nyáa][ອີກ|ìik][ສອງ|sǎwng][ປີ|pii][ແລ້ວ|lèeo] [ຂ້ອຍ|Khàwy][ຫວັງ|wǎng][ວ່າ|vàa][ເທື່ອ|thʉ̀a][ໜ້າ|nâa][ຊິ|si][ໄດ້|dâi][ໄປ|pai][ຊຽງຂວາງ|Síang-Khwǎang][ນຳ|nám][ເຈົ້າ|jâo]
lines.id: Next month. My contract has been extended for two more years. I hope next time I can go to Xiengkhouang with you.
lines.literal: month — next. I — continue — contract — more — two — year — already. I — hope — that — time — next — will — get — go — Xiengkhouang — along — you.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ໄດ້|Dâi][ແນ່ນອນ|nèe-nawn] [ແມ່|Mèe][ຂ້ອຍ|khàwy][ຖາມ|thǎam][ຫາ|hǎa][ເຈົ້າ|jâo][ເລື້ອຍໆ|lʉ̂ay-lʉ̂ay] [ເພິ່ນ|Phòen][ວ່າ|vàa][ເຈົ້າ|jâo][ຄື|khʉʉ][ລູກ|lûuk][ຄົນ|khón][ໜຶ່ງ|nʉ̀ng]
lines.id: You definitely can. My mother often asks about you. She says you're like one of her own children.
lines.literal: can — certain. mother — my — ask — seek — you — often-often. she — say — you — like — child — person — one.

lines.speaker: ບູດີ:
lines.text: [ຂ້ອຍ|Khàwy][ຊິ|si][ຄິດ|khit][ຮອດ|hâwt][ທຸກ|thuk][ຄົນ|khón] [ຝາກ|Fàak][ບອກ|bàwk][ແມ່|mèe][ແດ່|dèe][ເດີ້|dòe] [ຂອບໃຈ|Khàwp-jai][ສຳລັບ|sǎm-lap][ທຸກ|thuk][ຢ່າງ|yàang]
lines.id: I'll miss everyone. Please give my regards to your mother. Thank you for everything.
lines.literal: I — will — think — reach — every — person. entrust — tell — mother — a-little — (friendly particle). thank-you — for — every — kind.

lines.speaker: ບຸນມີ:
lines.text: [ເດີນທາງ|Dòen-tháang][ປອດໄພ|pàwt-phái][ເດີ້|dòe] [ພົບ|Phop][ກັນ|kan][ໃໝ່|mài] [ໂຊກດີ|Sôok-dii][ເດີ້|dòe][ໝູ່|mùu]
lines.id: Have a safe trip. See you again. Good luck, my friend.
lines.literal: travel — safe — (friendly particle). meet — together — new. good-luck — (friendly particle) — friend.

notes: **ທີ່ thìi = "that, which, who", and this is the word that turns short sentences into long ones.** *ປີທີ່ດີທີ່ສຸດ* (the year that was best), *ສິ່ງທີ່ຂ້ອຍມັກ* (the thing that I like), *ຄົນທີ່ຢູ່ພຸ້ນ* (the person who's over there). Until this unit, almost all your sentences were short; with *ທີ່*, you can link them without limit.

**ຄິດວ່າ khit vàa = "think that", ຮູ້ສຶກວ່າ hûu-sʉ̀k vàa = "feel that".** Both introduce an opinion, and both use the *ວ່າ* you've known since unit 13. For a more cautious opinion: *ຂ້ອຍວ່າ… khàwy vàa…* (I'd say…).

**ເພາະວ່າ phaw vàa = "because", ສະນັ້ນ sa-nân and ເລີຍ lóei = "so".** Interestingly, *ເລີຍ* here is its third use: "straight away" (unit 3), "at all" in negative sentences (unit 11), and now "so, as a result". Context separates the three, and your ear is used to it by now.

**ຢ້ານ yâan = "afraid".** *ຢ້ານເວົ້າຜິດ* (afraid of saying something wrong), *ບໍ່ຕ້ອງຢ້ານ* (no need to be afraid). That last phrase is the best advice for learning any language — and in Laos, it really holds true.
**ຜິດ phít = "wrong", ຖືກ thʉ̀ʉk = "right".** It already appeared in unit 3 as "cheap"; here is its other meaning. *ເວົ້າຜິດ* (say something wrong), *ເຮັດຖືກແລ້ວ* (you did it right).
**ພູມໃຈນຳ phúum-jai nám = "proud of".** Notice that "of" here is *ນຳ nám* (along, with) — not *ຫາ* or *ກັບ*. Lao has many prepositions that have to be learned together with their verbs.
**ເພິ່ນ phòen = respectful "he/she".** It's used for parents, teachers, bosses, and anyone you respect. Using *ລາວ láao* for someone's mother in front of them sounds less than polite.
**ເມື່ອໃດ mʉ̂a dai = "when".** It can go at the start or end of a sentence. Its more casual twin: *ຕອນໃດ tawn dai*. For the past, use *ຕອນນັ້ນ* (at that time).
**ເດີນທາງປອດໄພ dòen-tháang pàwt-phái = "have a safe trip", literally "travel free of danger".** It's the warmest and most common farewell for someone setting off on a long journey.

grammars.title: ທີ່: how to link sentences
body: Until now your sentences have been made of short pieces. The word *ທີ່ thìi* attaches a description to a noun, letting you stretch a sentence as far as you like. The order: **noun + ທີ່ + describing sentence**.

head: Lao
Say it
Meaning
rows: ຮ້ານທີ່ຢູ່ໃກ້ບ້ານ
ຄົນທີ່ຂ້ອຍພົບມື້ວານນີ້
ສິ່ງທີ່ຂ້ອຍມັກທີ່ສຸດ
ປຶ້ມທີ່ເຈົ້າໃຫ້ຂ້ອຍ
ມື້ທີ່ຝົນຕົກໜັກ
ອາຫານທີ່ບໍ່ເຜັດ

after: ⚠️ *ທີ່ thìi* also means "at, place" (*ທີ່ນີ້* — here) and appears in *ທີ່ສຸດ* (most). Three jobs, one word — and you've now met all three.

grammars.title: Giving opinions and responding

head: Lao
Say it
Meaning
How it feels
rows: ຂ້ອຍຄິດວ່າ…
ຂ້ອຍຮູ້ສຶກວ່າ…
ຂ້ອຍກໍຄິດຄືກັນ
ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ແນ່ໃຈ

after: Notice that even disagreement is gently wrapped: *ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ແນ່ໃຈ* (I'm not so sure) is used far more often than *ບໍ່ແມ່ນ* (that's wrong). It fits the *ບໍ່ເສຍໜ້າ* principle from unit 17.

sections.title: Expressing feelings: the ໃຈ word family

blocks.text: All twelve words above are built from **ໃຈ *jai*** (heart). Lao — like Thai — places almost the whole world of feelings in that one word. When you meet a new word containing *ໃຈ*, you already know it's about feelings; you just have to guess which way from its partner word.

blocks.text: **ຢູ່ດີມີແຮງ *yùu dii míi héeng*** — literally "live well, have strength" — is the most characteristically Lao and the deepest of these phrases. It isn't just "stay healthy"; it's a blessing that your life go well and your strength be enough. You'll hear it from elders, and saying it back is the best way to close a meeting.

items: **About 700 words**, including all the core vocabulary of everyday conversation: greetings, numbers, time, food, the body, family, weather, directions, and feelings.

**The whole A1 grammar framework**: asking with ten question words, negating with *ບໍ່* and *ບໍ່ແມ່ນ*, marking time with *ແລ້ວ*, *ຊິ*, *ເຄີຍ*, *ກຳລັງ*, and building long sentences with *ທີ່* and *ວ່າ*.
**The ability to read Lao script** — slowly, but for real. Once you can split a run of text with no spaces and recognize the twenty-seven consonants, street signs will start reading themselves.

**Most important: knowing how things are done.** When to use *ບໍ່ຄ່ອຍ* instead of *ບໍ່*. Why *ໄວ້ເທື່ອໜ້າ* usually means no. Why you mustn't point with your feet. None of that is grammar, but it's what makes people glad to talk with you.

blocks.text: Now close this book, find one Lao person, and start with *ສະບາຍດີ*. The rest will come on its own.
*ຢູ່ດີມີແຮງເດີ້! Yùu dii míi héeng dòe!*

exercises.prompt: Translate into Lao. This is the last exercise in the book — do it without looking back at earlier units.
items: A year went by fast, didn't it?
I think this has been the best year of my life.
When I first arrived, I couldn't say a single word.
Because you helped me practice every week.
At first I was really scared, but Lao people are so kind.
Thank you for everything. See you again.

answers: ຮ້ານທີ່ຢູ່ໃກ້ບ້ານ — ຄົນທີ່ຂ້ອຍພົບມື້ວານນີ້ — ປຶ້ມທີ່ເຈົ້າໃຫ້ຂ້ອຍ — ອາຫານທີ່ບໍ່ເຜັດ — ມື້ທີ່ຝົນຕົກໜັກ
ແມ່ນແລ້ວ ຮ້ອນຫຼາຍ — ຂ້ອຍກໍຄິດຄືກັນ — ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ແນ່ໃຈ — ຈິງບໍ່ — ບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ
ຂ້ອຍຄິດວ່າປີນີ້ເປັນປີທີ່ດີທີ່ສຸດໃນຊີວິດ — ຂ້ອຍພູມໃຈນຳເຈົ້າ — ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ຢ້ານເວົ້າຜິດ — ເດີນທາງປອດໄພເດີ້ — ຂອບໃຈສຳລັບທຸກຢ່າງ
ປີໜຶ່ງຜ່ານໄປໄວເນາະ — ຂ້ອຍຄິດວ່າປີນີ້ເປັນປີທີ່ດີທີ່ສຸດໃນຊີວິດ — ຕອນມາໃໝ່ໆ ຂ້ອຍເວົ້າບໍ່ໄດ້ຈັກຄຳ — ເພາະວ່າເຈົ້າຊ່ວຍຝຶກໃຫ້ທຸກອາທິດ — ຕອນທຳອິດຢ້ານຫຼາຍ ແຕ່ຄົນລາວໃຈດີຫຼາຍ — ຂອບໃຈສຳລັບທຸກຢ່າງ ພົບກັນໃໝ່
